title: 美股盘前：AI股喘息带动纳指期货涨0.89%，油价跌逾4%；OKTA获纳入标普500正反馈
summary: 截至05:15 ET，道指与标普500期货各涨0.52%，纳指100期货涨0.89%；油价跌逾4%，10年期美债收益率降至4.911%。AI交易在十月重挫后修复，但周二中期选举与今晚AAPL、PLTR财报令追涨仍需价格确认。

关键词云图

A股开盘企稳 光通信双市场确认 美股科技抛售 港股相对韧性 短端流动性 TCL业绩待确认 设备扩产承接 汽车盈利压力 重组停牌 PMI回落 排行部分可得 乌镇AI议题

重大新闻汇总
宏观
10月制造业PMI降至49.3
国家统计局数据显示，生产指数49.8、新订单49.4；大型企业PMI为50.2，中小企业分别为48.4和47.5，总量需求偏弱。来源：国家统计局。
结构
高技术与装备制造仍处扩张区间
官方解读显示高技术制造业PMI为51.3、装备制造业为50.6，电子通信及航空航天等生产与新订单指数不低于53，结构好于总量。来源：国家统计局。
政策
隔夜逆回购延续至11月2日，重点是平滑资金面
央行已安排10月21日至11月2日开展隔夜逆回购、每日上限1万亿元；这是短端流动性管理，不等同于全面宽松。来源：上海市金融办转述央行公告。
产业
乌镇峰会11月2日启幕
议题包括AI开源生态、智能体互操作、具身与空间智能；政策与会议热度需等待订单和A/H价格确认。来源：中央网信办。
市场
A/H开盘企稳，周五科技去风险未全面延续
09:35延迟行情显示上证约跌0.10%、创业板约涨0.25%、恒指约涨0.50%；指数未延续周五单边科技抛售，但今日实时宽度与恒生科技指数未从同一接口取得，仍需保留不确定性。来源：东方财富公开行情。
美股
Intel引发半导体与AI硬件去风险
周五Intel跌约30%，纳指跌2.86%、费半跌7.2%；AMD、Nvidia、Broadcom、Micron等普遍下跌，A/H芯片与算力链开盘先看承接。来源：Reuters。
夜盘
周日夜美股期指小幅反弹，未扭转周五技术破坏
截至周日夜可得延迟行情，道指、标普500和纳指100期货约涨0.3%、0.4%和0.6%；Brent亚洲早段约跌1.7%至111.60美元，反弹暂属风险缓冲。来源：IBD延迟行情。
业绩
TCL科技利润增长，周末披露后尚待确认
前三季归母净利润51.2亿元、同比增68.06%，扣非净利润增70.96%；10月30日收4.50元、涨0.90%，但报告周末披露，不能把此前价格当公告后确认。来源：巨潮资讯。
业绩
长飞光纤业绩获A/H同步价格确认
第三季营收93.16亿元、归母净利润32.03亿元；09:35 A股约266.67元、涨5.45%，H股约100.20港元、涨4.21%，双双收复首轮确认位，业绩催化获得跨市场价格确认。来源：上交所公告、东方财富公开行情。
项目
屹唐股份拟投180亿元建设集成电路装备基地
项目聚焦干法去胶、快速热处理、干法刻蚀及等离子表面处理；10月30日收17.39元、涨1.93%，公告后交易反馈仍待周一验证。来源：公司公告镜像。
业绩
赛力斯利润质量与现金流承压
前三季归母净亏损2.97亿元、扣非净亏损37.44亿元、经营现金流净额-145.11亿元；A/H股10月30日分别跌2.73%和2.79%，列为回避。来源：上交所。
停牌
TCL中环与中国稀土筹划重组并停牌
两家公司均自11月2日开市停牌，方案仍处筹划、关联交易及审批存在不确定性；停牌状态本身不构成可执行多头信号。来源：TCL中环公告、中国稀土公告。

美股夜盘行情总结

夜盘指数
周五科技重挫，周日夜期指仅温和反弹
10月30日标普500跌1.82%、纳指跌2.86%、费半跌7.2%；周日夜延迟期指约涨0.3%-0.6%，不足以抹平周五跌幅。
板块对照
美股榜单仍偏防御，代表股盘前报价本轮不可得
行业Top5为抵押贷款金融、化学制品、污染治理、糖果、油气钻探；概念Top5含枪械、减肥药、体育博彩、页岩油。行业Bottom5抓取超时，且本轮未取得代表股有效盘前报价，不能把榜单方向直接判为延续。
A/H映射
开盘反馈转为“指数企稳、光通信分化修复”
09:35上证约-0.10%、创业板约+0.25%、恒指约+0.50%；长飞A/H约+5.45%/+4.21%确认业绩映射，TCL科技约-0.89%仍未确认。若长飞失守252.88元/96.15港元或指数再度扩大跌幅，修复判断失效。

盘前结论

事实：09:35上证约跌0.10%、创业板约涨0.25%、恒指约涨0.50%，周五科技抛售没有在A/H指数层面单边延续；长飞光纤A/H约涨5.45%和4.21%，同时收复首轮确认位。

判断：短线基线由“全面科技去风险”调整为“指数企稳、光通信等业绩线选择性修复”。 周五费半重挫与PMI偏弱仍限制追高，且今日实时宽度和恒生科技指数未由同一数据源确认。

执行：长飞升级为看多候选；TCL科技与屹唐维持条件关注；赛力斯即使反弹也不因负面基本面未变而包装为多头，TCL中环停牌继续回避。

重点个股关注

TCL科技
SZ.000100
条件关注

事实与状态：前三季归母净利润51.2亿元、同比增68.06%；09:35约4.46元、跌0.89%，低于4.50元首轮确认位，业绩尚未获价格确认。

确认条件：重新站上4.50元并持续强于电子板块，且半导体材料改善得到量价承接。

风险与失效条件：光伏供需失衡与集团杠杆仍高；若继续弱于电子板块或跌破4.37元早盘低点，取消关注。

长飞光纤
SH.601869 / HK.06869
看多候选

事实与状态：第三季营收93.16亿元、归母净利润32.03亿元；09:35 A/H约266.67元和100.20港元、涨5.45%和4.21%，均收复首轮确认位。

确认条件：A/H持续守住252.88元与96.15港元，并保持相对通信设备板块强势，视为业绩催化延续。

风险与失效条件：周五美股光通信与半导体仍受压；任一市场跌回确认位下方、或A/H明显分化，降回条件关注。

屹唐股份
SH.688729
条件关注

事实与状态：拟投180亿元建设集成电路装备基地；09:35约17.70元、涨1.78%，公告获得初步承接但力度有限。

确认条件：继续强于科创50/半导体设备，同时等待资金、建设节奏与订单能见度。

风险与失效条件：资本开支规模大、兑现周期长；跌回17.39元下方或板块转弱则失效。

赛力斯
SH.601127 / HK.09927
回避

事实与状态：前三季归母净亏损2.97亿元、扣非净亏损37.44亿元、经营现金流净额-145.11亿元；09:35 A/H约涨1.65%和1.36%，一次反弹未改变利润质量。

再评估条件：等待销量、扣非利润和经营现金流同步改善，并出现A/H持续相对强势。

风险与失效条件：零部件成本、研发投入和销量压力仍在，当前不包装为多头。

TCL中环
SZ.002129
回避

事实与状态：筹划购买中环领先少数股权并自11月2日起停牌；前三季归母净亏损45.56亿元，09:35仍无可交易价格。

再评估条件：复牌后再核对交易定价、摊薄/协同、审批和真实价格反馈。

风险与失效条件：停牌期间不可交易，光伏供需失衡与关联交易不确定性突出，不将重组预期当作可执行推荐。

板块轮动看板

确认修复长飞A/H同步上涨并收复确认位，光通信从负反馈转为业绩线选择性修复。
指数基线上证近平、创业板与恒指小幅上涨，全面去风险暂未延续。
仍待确认TCL科技低于4.50元；屹唐虽上涨，但扩产兑现仍需订单和资金验证。
风险方向赛力斯亏损与现金流压力、TCL中环停牌和周五费半重挫仍构成约束。

逻辑链

PMI偏弱与周五美股科技重挫设定防守基线。
09:35 A/H指数企稳，否定科技风险无差别延伸的极端情景。
长飞A/H同时收复确认位，将周末业绩从未验证催化升级为跨市场价格确认。
因此只升级长飞，其余标的按各自价格和基本面证据维持条件关注或回避。

风险雷达

周五费半跌7.2%，一次A/H开盘修复尚不足以消除外部科技估值压力。
10月制造业PMI为49.3，总量需求仍偏弱。
今日实时市场宽度与恒生科技指数未从同一行情接口取得，指数结论仅基于已核验报价。
行业Bottom5抓取超时；代表股盘前报价不可得，不能把美股榜单方向视为已确认延续。
停牌、重组、项目投资和周末业绩均有执行与价格回撤风险。

数据来源与时间点

规则：最新main的brief_rules.md（SHA 136f8358）。08:30首轮截止08:40 CST；09:15复核抓取于09:35 CST，增量报价10项，4组指数/候选联动进入判断。开盘行情为东方财富公开延迟报价；AKShare云端快照仍为2026-10-30，未冒充今日实时宽度；Moomoo排行快照为2026-10-31 08:48 CST，行业仅Top5、Bottom5超时，概念Top5完整。

BullishBearishNeutralw1-w5 shows attention/importance, not percentage change.
Major news
Macro
October manufacturing PMI falls to 49.3
NBS reported production at 49.8 and new orders at 49.4; large firms were at 50.2 while medium and small firms were at 48.4 and 47.5, showing weak aggregate demand. Source: NBS.
Structure
High-tech and equipment manufacturing remain in expansion
The official commentary put high-tech manufacturing PMI at 51.3 and equipment manufacturing at 50.6; electronics/communications and aerospace production and new orders were at least 53. Source: NBS.
Policy
Overnight reverse repos run through Nov 2 to smooth funding
The announced Oct 21-Nov 2 operations have a CNY1tn daily cap. This is short-end liquidity management, not blanket easing. Source: Shanghai financial authority summary of the PBOC notice.
Industry
Wuzhen Summit opens on Nov 2
Topics include open-source AI, agent interoperability, embodied intelligence and spatial intelligence; policy attention still requires order and price confirmation. Source: CAC.
Market
A/H markets stabilise at the open; Friday's tech de-risking does not extend uniformly
At 09:35 delayed quotes had Shanghai about -0.10%, ChiNext +0.25% and Hang Seng +0.50%. The one-way Friday tech selloff did not extend, but live breadth and HSTECH were unavailable from the same feed, so uncertainty remains. Source: Eastmoney public quotes.
US
Intel triggers de-risking across semiconductors and AI hardware
Intel fell about 30% Friday, the Nasdaq 2.86% and the SOX 7.2%; AMD, Nvidia, Broadcom and Micron also dropped, setting a high bar for A/H chips and compute. Source: Reuters.
Overnight
Sunday-night US futures rebound modestly
Delayed Sunday-night quotes had Dow, S&P 500 and Nasdaq 100 futures up about 0.3%, 0.4% and 0.6%; Brent was down about 1.7% near $111.60 in early Asia, only a partial risk buffer. Source: IBD delayed quotes.
Results
TCL Technology profit rises; weekend disclosure awaits confirmation
Nine-month attributable profit was CNY5.12bn, up 68.06%, and adjusted profit rose 70.96%. The stock closed Oct 30 at CNY4.50, up 0.90%, but that pre-report price is not post-disclosure confirmation. Source: CNINFO.
Results
YOFC earnings receive dual-market price confirmation
Q3 revenue was CNY9.316bn and attributable profit CNY3.203bn. At 09:35 the A/H shares were about CNY266.67/HKD100.20, up 5.45%/4.21%, reclaiming both first-run confirmation levels. Sources: SSE filing and Eastmoney public quotes.
Project
E-Town Semiconductor plans a CNY18bn equipment base
The base focuses on dry strip, RTP, dry etch and plasma surface treatment. Shares closed Oct 30 at CNY17.39, up 1.93%; post-release trading confirmation is still pending. Source: company filing mirror.
Results
SERES faces earnings-quality and cash-flow pressure
Nine-month attributable loss was CNY297m, adjusted loss CNY3.744bn and operating cash flow -CNY14.511bn; the A/H shares fell 2.73%/2.79% Friday, making it an avoid. Source: SSE.
Suspension
TCL Zhonghuan and China Rare Earth suspend for planned restructurings
Both suspend from the Nov 2 open while terms remain preliminary and approval/related-party risks remain; a suspension is not an executable bullish signal. Sources: TCL Zhonghuan, China Rare Earth.

US Overnight Trading Summary

Night index
Friday's tech rout meets only a modest Sunday-night futures rebound
On Oct 30 the S&P 500 fell 1.82%, Nasdaq 2.86% and SOX 7.2%; delayed Sunday-night futures rose roughly 0.3%-0.6%, not enough to erase Friday's decline.
Sector comparison
US rankings stay defensive; valid premarket quotes for leaders are unavailable
Industry Top5 are Mortgage Finance, Chemicals, Pollution Control, Confectioners and Oil & Gas Drilling; concept Top5 include Firearms, Weight-loss Drugs, Sports Betting and Shale Oil. Industry Bottom5 timed out and valid premarket leader quotes were unavailable, so continuation cannot be assumed.
A/H mapping
The open shifts the signal to index stabilisation and selective optics repair
At 09:35 Shanghai was about -0.10%, ChiNext +0.25% and Hang Seng +0.50%; YOFC A/H at +5.45%/+4.21% confirms the results mapping, while TCL Technology at -0.89% remains unconfirmed. A break below CNY252.88/HKD96.15 or renewed index losses invalidates the repair view.

Pre-open conclusion

Facts: At 09:35 Shanghai was about -0.10%, ChiNext +0.25% and Hang Seng +0.50%, so Friday's tech selloff did not extend one-way at the A/H index level. YOFC A/H rose about 5.45%/4.21% and reclaimed both first-run confirmation levels.

View: The near-term baseline shifts from broad tech de-risking to index stabilisation with selective earnings-led repair in optics. Friday's SOX rout and weak PMI still cap chasing, while live breadth and HSTECH were not confirmed by the same feed.

Execution: YOFC is upgraded to a bullish candidate; TCL Technology and E-Town remain conditional watches. SERES is not turned bullish by one rebound because its negative fundamentals persist, and suspended TCL Zhonghuan remains an avoid.

Priority stock setups

TCL Technology
SZ.000100
Conditional watch

Facts and status: Nine-month attributable profit was CNY5.12bn, up 68.06%. At 09:35 shares were about CNY4.46, down 0.89% and below the CNY4.50 first-run trigger, so results remain unconfirmed by price.

Confirmation: Reclaim CNY4.50 and sustain outperformance versus electronics with volume support for the semiconductor-material improvement.

Risks/invalidation: Solar oversupply and group leverage remain high; continued sector underperformance or a break below the CNY4.37 morning low cancels the setup.

YOFC
SH.601869 / HK.06869
Bullish candidate

Facts and status: Q3 revenue was CNY9.316bn and attributable profit CNY3.203bn. At 09:35 A/H were about CNY266.67/HKD100.20, up 5.45%/4.21%, both above the first-run triggers.

Confirmation: Hold CNY252.88/HKD96.15 in both markets and retain relative strength versus communications equipment to confirm earnings follow-through.

Risks/invalidation: US optics and semiconductors remain under pressure after Friday. A break below either trigger or sharp A/H divergence downgrades the setup to conditional watch.

E-Town Semiconductor
SH.688729
Conditional watch

Facts and status: It plans a CNY18bn chip-equipment base. At 09:35 shares were about CNY17.70, up 1.78%, initial but moderate support for the catalyst.

Confirmation: Continue to outperform STAR 50/chip equipment while funding, construction cadence and order visibility improve.

Risks/invalidation: Capex is large and the ramp long; a move below CNY17.39 or renewed sector weakness invalidates the setup.

SERES
SH.601127 / HK.09927
Avoid

Facts and status: Nine-month attributable loss was CNY297m, adjusted loss CNY3.744bn and operating cash flow -CNY14.511bn. A/H rose about 1.65%/1.36% at 09:35, but one rebound does not fix earnings quality.

Reassessment: Wait for simultaneous improvement in deliveries, adjusted profit and operating cash flow plus persistent A/H relative strength.

Risks/invalidation: Component costs, R&D intensity and sales pressure persist; the stock is not presented as bullish.

TCL Zhonghuan
SZ.002129
Avoid

Facts and status: It plans to buy minority interests in Zhonghuan Advanced and is suspended from Nov 2. Nine-month attributable loss was CNY4.556bn and no tradable 09:35 quote exists.

Reassessment: After resumption, verify transaction pricing, dilution/synergies, approvals and actual price feedback.

Risks/invalidation: The stock cannot trade during suspension; solar oversupply and related-party uncertainty prevent an executable bullish call.

Sector rotation board

Confirmed repairYOFC A/H jointly rallied and reclaimed triggers, shifting optics to selective earnings-led repair.
Index baselineShanghai is near flat while ChiNext and Hang Seng are modestly higher, so broad de-risking has not extended.
Still unconfirmedTCL remains below CNY4.50; E-Town is higher but capex still needs funding and order evidence.
Risk areasSERES losses/cash flow, TCL Zhonghuan's suspension and Friday's SOX rout remain constraints.

Logic chain

Weak PMI and Friday's US tech rout set a defensive baseline.
The 09:35 A/H index stabilisation rejects indiscriminate extension of tech risk unwinding.
YOFC A/H jointly reclaimed triggers, upgrading weekend results to cross-market price confirmation.
Only YOFC is upgraded; other names stay conditional or avoid based on their own price and fundamental evidence.

Risk radar

Friday's SOX fell 7.2%; one A/H opening repair does not remove external tech valuation pressure.
October manufacturing PMI at 49.3 still signals weak aggregate demand.
Live breadth and HSTECH were unavailable from the same quote feed, so the index view uses only verified quotes.
Industry Bottom5 timed out and valid US premarket leader quotes were unavailable; ranking direction is not confirmed continuation.
Suspensions, restructurings, capex and weekend results carry execution and drawdown risk.
